projects.title: Shaolinquan Hu - Website
projects.description: Informational website for a Chinese martial arts school. The purpose of this project was to provide a way to showcase the school's history and philosophy, along with visual content (images and videos) displaying the institution's activities. It also includes communication channels for obtaining information about classes, all presented in a simple manner for interested users.

projects.title: Currency Value Application
projects.description: Web page that provides information about the exchange rate in Argentine pesos ($ARS) of the main types of dollars available in Argentina. This is achieved by consuming data from an API and displaying it in an HTML view.

projects.title: Shaolinquan Hu Administration Platform
projects.description: The project consists of an API that provides CRUD operations to facilitate the management of student, teacher, and dojo information for a Chinese martial arts school. Additionally, a web client consumes the API and interacts with users in a friendly manner, allowing registration and access to consult, add, modify, and delete information according to their user role. The web client also provides user communication via email, notifying them when their account request is approved or rejected.
